passive.name: Runic Blade
passive.description: Riven's abilities charge her blade, and her basic attacks expend charges to deal an additional damage.

spells.name: Broken Wings
spells.description: Riven lashes out in a series of strikes. This ability can be reactivated three times in a short time frame with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies.
spells.tooltip:
Riven dashes forward, dealing {{ firstslashdamage }} physical damage. She can Recast this Ability twice. The first Recast is the same as the original, but the second has a different effect:

Recast: Riven leaps forward and slams, dealing {{ firstslashdamage }} physical damage and Knocks Up nearby enemies for 0.75 seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Ki Burst
spells.description: Riven emits a Ki Burst, damaging and stunning nearby enemies.
spells.tooltip: Riven's sword emits a burst of runic energy, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> and <status>Stunning</status> for {{ stunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Valor
spells.description: Riven steps forward a short distance and blocks incoming damage.
spells.tooltip: Riven quickly dashes and gains <shield>{{ totalshield }} Shield</shield> for 1.5 seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Blade of the Exile
spells.description: Riven empowers her keepsake weapon with energy, and gains Attack Damage and Range. During this time, she also gains the ability to use Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack, once.
spells.tooltip:
Riven's weapon surges with spiritual energy, granting her {{ bonusad }} Attack Damage and increased range on damaging Abilities and Attacks for {{ duration }} seconds. While active, she can Recast.

Recast: Riven fires a wind slash that deals between {{ mindamage }} and {{ maxdamage }} physical damage, based on their missing Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

variants.name: Runic Blade
effects: Innate: Riven's ability casts generate a stack of Charge for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 3 times. Riven's basic attacks are empowered to each consume a stack to deal bonus physical damage equal to 30% : 50% (based on level) AD, reduced to[ 50% ][ 15% : 25% (based on level) AD ]against structures.
The bonus damage is affected by critical strike modifiers and applies life steal at 100% effectiveness.

variants.name: Broken Wings
effects: Active: Riven can activate Broken Wings three times before the ability goes on cooldown, with a 0.3125-second static cooldown between casts. If Riven does not recast the ability within 4 seconds of the previous cast, it goes on cooldown.

First Cast: Riven dashes 225 units in the direction she is currently facing, or up to 225 units towards the target enemy, striking enemies in the target area 100 units away. This cast cannot cross terrain.
Second Cast: Riven mimics the first cast's effects.
Third Cast: Riven mimics the first cast's effects in a larger area while also knocking back enemies hit 75 units over 0.5 seconds. This cast can cross terrain.

variants.name: Valor
effects: Riven can cast any of her abilities during the dash. Valor will cast at max range if cast beyond that.

variants.name: Blade of the Exile
effects: Active: Riven empowers her blade for 15 seconds, gaining 25% AD bonus attack damage, 75 bonus attack range, and increased range on Broken Wings and Ki Burst. After 0.5 seconds, she can cast Wind Slash within the duration.
